text:
Ava (Marketing): uploaded the first draft of the enterprise one-pager for the upcoming launch + webinar. focus: security + SLA guarantees + deploy-mode decision flow. please skim — aiming to send invites and the public page by EOD. figma: https://figma.redwood/enterprise-onepager-v0.2 and doc: https://docs.redwood/one-pager-enterprise-draft

Miguel (Growth): reading now. overall strong. suggestion: move the customer-facing hero to cost predictability + compliance tie-in. also recommend a 1-line benchmark callout under the hero (latency p95 and relative cost vs self-host).

Priya (Field): quick ask on inbound routing — what tags should SDRs add? we need to route private/VPC interest to AE Specialist, Dedicated interest to Capacity team, and Security + Compliance RFPs to Solutions. recommend form checkboxes: "Private/VPC", "Dedicated / Reserved Capacity", "Compliance Review (SOC2/HIPAA)".

Sam (Product): add a small bullet explaining automated fallback behavior (model variants and region routing). customers will ask about what happens during capacity spikes. also we should be explicit about what our SLA covers vs. best-effort features. draft phrasing: ```SLA: 99.95% control-plane uptime; 95th/99th token-level latency SLOs depend on model and sequence length — see appendix.```

Jordan (SRE): re latency phrasing — don't promise absolute numbers in hero. recommend: "typical 95th percentile latency under 200–350ms for chat workloads; consult your workload profile for long context runs." also add a short note about audit logs + KMS/HSM integrations (customers ask this first).

Miguel (Growth): proposed hero copy (option A):
```
Predictable inference for regulated teams — secure VPC & SLA-backed serving that keeps latency and cost under control.
```
Option B (short): ```Secure, SLA-backed LLM inference for enterprise apps.```
Which one do we prefer for the page vs. the webinar invite?

Ava (Marketing): leaning toward option A on the website and option B in email subject lines. also want a 2-sentence benchmark blurb we can quote in the hero area. Miguel — can you draft a 1-line benchmark: what we measured vs. typical self-hosted baseline? include tokens/sec and cost per 1k tokens if possible.

Priya (Field): inbound routing details — suggest SDR tag mapping: 
- private_vpc -> solutions-eng
- dedicated_capacity -> capacity-ops
- compliance_rfp -> solutions + sales_eng
Also add contact priority if tag includes "enterprise:yes". For qualification, add quick Qs: "Data residency required?", "Dedicated GPU required?", "Compliance certs needed?"

Maya (Security): can we have the compliance matrix attached before we publish? we'll need mapping to SOC2 / HIPAA / FedRAMP posture. I'll run through the sheet today but pls don't push external assets until I confirm phrasing on encryption and audit logs.

Jordan (SRE): also flag: the SLA language needs an exceptions clause for customer-managed on-prem packages. we'll add a small parenthetical.

Ava (Marketing): timeline check — webinar tentative date set by calendarbot: May 10 11:00am PT (calendarbot). Need final one-pager + marketing page by May 5 to enable invites and partner co-promos. Anyone blocking?

Miguel (Growth): I'll take the benchmark narrative and a short competitor-comparison blurb (1 sentence) by EOD tomorrow.

Sam (Product): I'll add the fallback/rollout diagram and a short appendix note on performance variance by model length.

Priya (Field): I'll write the SDR routing doc + checkbox copy and the 3 qualification questions. Also can draft a short playbook for enterprise leads (first 48h).

Maya (Security): I'll confirm compliance copy by COB tomorrow. If legal needs review, escalate with the compliance matrix linked.

Ava (Marketing): perfect — last items: (1) callout badges we want on the one-pager: "SOC 2 Type II", "KMS/HSM", "SLA-backed", "Dedicated Options" — confirm wording. (2) add a short customer quote placeholder (we'll swap after beta).

Jordan (SRE): thumbs-up on badges. for the "SLA-backed" badge link to the SLA appendix rather than an absolute claim on the hero.

Ava (Marketing): ok — I'll push v0.3 to figma after Miguel + Maya sign off. tagging everyone for visibility :point_up: :rocket:

calendarbot: provisional webinar event created — "Enterprise Inference: Secure & Predictable" 2026-05-10 11:00 PT. RSVP link: https://events.redwood/webinar-enterprise-inference

Miguel (Growth): quick microcopy suggestion for email RSVP CTA: "Save your seat — see how enterprise teams cut inference costs and lock in SLAs."

Ava (Marketing): noted. thanks all — action items summary: Miguel = benchmark blurb, Maya = compliance copy, Sam = diagram, Priya = routing/playbook, Jordan = SLA phrasing check. I'll assemble final one-pager v0.3 and ping for final signoff before publish.

Priya (Field): thanks — I'll sync with SDR leads once routing tags are finalized. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Security): will post comments in the doc, please don't publish until I approve the compliance section.

Ava (Marketing): got it. end thread for now — will re-open if any blockers.
